rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2011).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2011 as 'Let There Be Love'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, darker reverse. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
